campaigns.name: Campus Ambassadors
campaigns.audience: Students hearing about the event through peer representatives
campaigns.objective: Turn peer conversations into identified interest and completed registrations

campaigns.name: Paid Social
campaigns.audience: Students discovering the event through paid social content
campaigns.objective: Acquire new interest and test progression from clicks to registration

campaigns.name: Creator Partners
campaigns.audience: Students engaging with creator-led event content
campaigns.objective: Move creator-content engagement toward programme exploration and registration

campaigns.name: College Partnerships
campaigns.audience: College clubs and groups exploring participation together
campaigns.objective: Help group organizers progress from programme questions to confirmed attendance

campaigns.name: Student Referrals
campaigns.audience: Friends invited by already interested students
campaigns.objective: Convert invited friends while tracking registration completion

campaigns.name: Organic Search
campaigns.audience: People actively searching for event information
campaigns.objective: Help information-seeking visitors find details and complete registration

campaigns.name: Community Groups
campaigns.audience: Members of student interest and community groups
campaigns.objective: Nurture community interest without over-contacting people who opt out
